description: This source file defines an enumeration LocationCurrentRequest with functions for resolving current location given a location manager, including handling cache, accuracy, and timeout logic.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the current location, using cache if valid, or requesting a new location with a specified timeout.

methods.description: Converts a custom accuracy enumeration to Core Location's accuracy constants.
